$comment: Outstanding spacing-check breaches on pages this wave did not own.
Every entry names a page, a selector fragment that matches the finding,
and a reason. spacing-check.mjs FAILS on a finding no entry covers, and
FAILS on an entry that no longer covers a finding — so the list cannot
grow stale and cannot be used to bury a page. Delete the entry when the
page is fixed; the check then fails until you do.
All eleven are the same defect: a column of cards with no declared gap,
so two bordered blocks share an edge. Fix is one word per page — put
`vstack` on the column wrapper, or give the dead `.grid` class a
`display` so the inline grid-template-columns it already declares applies.

outstanding.why: the side column is a bare <div>; its cards share an edge. fix: el('div','vstack')
main and side are bare <div>s; members card and danger card share an edge. fix: el('div','vstack')
left and right are bare <div>s. fix: el('div','vstack')
main and side are bare <div>s. fix: el('div','vstack')
the member picker stacks role=checkbox cards with no gap and no hairline; unlike a segmented control there is no shared track, so they read as one block
dead .grid class: gap and grid-template-columns are declared inline but no rule sets display, so the notes callout lays out as a flush block stack
